Hi Tom + Priya,

Thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick note — looks like the meeting URL rotated at the time of the call and Priya didn't receive the updated join link, which meant we missed the technical follow-up we had planned. I'm really sorry about the hiccup.

Recap (very high level):
- Goal: evaluate Redwood inference for their patient-facing summarization pipeline; focus on latency and data residency requirements.
- Next proposed step: 45–60 minute technical deep-dive with your infra/security lead and our runtime team.

To get us moving, two windows I can offer (both PDT):
- Tue Jun 15, 08:30–09:30 PDT / 11:30–12:30 EDT
- Wed Jun 16, 15:00–16:00 PDT / 18:00–19:00 EDT

If neither works, tell me two windows that suit your infra/security lead and I'll coordinate on our side. I've attached a short mutual action plan to make scheduling and prerequisites (SAML settings, sample payloads, non-prod dataset) concrete.

Also: I'm dropping Ben and Marissa on this thread to help lock calendar logistics and to capture any procurement/compliance asks up front.

Thanks — Naomi
